architecture.agentTurnRequest: immutable Provider execution evidence after claim answers what was actually dispatched
architecture.canonicalHistory: append-only Harness Journal/CAS evidence answers what happened
architecture.workingSetSpec: Agent-owned revisioned selection state answers what this attempt chooses to focus on
architecture.workingView: deterministic rebuildable projection answers what the model sees for this turn

behavior.commit: a committed Working Set is frozen for that attempt; caller/domain rejection may lead to a new explicit replan attempt linked to the committed predecessor
behavior.concurrency: Working Set transition is revalidated under the Run lease so two writers based on one revision cannot both advance the head
behavior.privacy: the Run Contract privacy policy remains authoritative: metadata-only does not persist exact model request content and rejects the current Working Set content prototype
behavior.providerEvidence: Provider Call v3 binds an exact AgentTurnRequest CAS object when model-content persistence is authorized; historical/default v2 remains supported
behavior.recovery: a projected no-Tool turn can keep HarnessRunState.messages empty, recover the committed Working Set, rebuild the same Working View, and replay an already-completed Provider result without physical redispatch
behavior.workingSetIdentity: pins bind a logical reference/generation to an exact Harness CAS source object digest; logical-current drift cannot silently retarget an existing pin

conclusion: P-C1.1 proves that durable Run history, Agent-owned Working Set state, model-visible Working View, and exact Provider request evidence can be separated without weakening existing Run revision, concurrency, privacy, crash-recovery, or Provider replay laws. The proof is intentionally limited to a one-turn no-Tool projected execution path and does not replace the mature multi-turn Agent Loop.
knownLimits: The mature OrdivonAgentLoop still uses append-only HarnessRunState.messages for multi-turn and Tool-bearing execution; P-C1.1 has not migrated that path.
WorkingViewNoToolTurnRunner is an intentionally narrow prototype and is not exported from the recommended ordivon_harness.api surface.
No Context discovery, search, ranking, RAG, Memory, automatic summarization, evidence-sufficiency scoring, or Context scheduler is introduced.
HarnessWorkingViewSource currently contains already-materialized model messages; a generic Context object/address space remains experimental.
Exact AgentTurnRequest content persistence requires HarnessPrivacyPolicy.allow_model_content=True; metadata-only Runs retain digest-only Provider evidence.

motivation.financePattern: canonical history/evidence remains durable while Agent-facing projections are replaceable and exact identities are version-bound
motivation.primeAgentFinding: append-only model-visible transcript caused Agent-controlled Context acquisition to exhaust request capacity even when the Agent only needed a small current Working Set
